about.title: ABOUT ME
about.subtitle: Hi there, I'm Riddhi!
bioParagraphs: I am a Bachelor of Science in Information Technology graduate from the University of Mumbai, seeking an entry-level role in SQL, Web Development, Java, or Manual Testing to apply my technical skills and grow professionally.

Highly adaptable, quick to learn, and details-oriented, I enjoy building clean web interfaces, writing structured SQL queries, creating interactive Power BI dashboards, and ensuring software quality through meticulous testing.

skillsTitle: A toolkit for building reliable software & data insights.
skillsSubtitle: Foundation in web technology, SQL databases, Power BI analytics, Java programming, and software testing methodologies.

experience.title: Data Analytics Intern
experience.description: Successfully completed a one-month internship in Data Analytics at BizTech IT Solutions. Built interactive Power BI dashboards for Retail Sales, Healthcare Analytics, and Consumer Shopping Trends to enable data-driven business decisions.

experience.title: Manual Testing Course
experience.description: Completed an intensive 1-year manual testing course covering software testing life cycle (STLC), bug reporting, test execution, and test case design methodologies.

education.title: Bachelor of Science in Information Technology
education.description: Focused on databases, software engineering, programming methodologies, data analytics, and web technologies.

education.title: Higher Secondary Certificate (H.S.C)
education.description: Completed Higher Secondary education in Science stream with focus on Physics, Mathematics, and Computer Science foundation.

education.title: Secondary School Certificate (S.S.C)
education.description: Completed secondary education with strong academic foundation in Mathematics, General Science, and English.

caseStudies.title: EXER COACH GYM
caseStudies.goal: Build a comprehensive gym management system for coaches to track member progress, create workout plans, and manage leads.
caseStudies.approach: Developed a full-stack web application with role-based access control. Implemented lead management, member progress tracking, and gallery features.

caseStudies.title: RETAIL & WAREHOUSE SALES DASHBOARD
caseStudies.platforms: Power BI, SQL, DAX, Excel, Data Modeling
caseStudies.goal: Analyze retail vs. warehouse sales performance, track category transfers (Liquor, Wine, Beer, Non-Alcohol, Store Supplies), and evaluate monthly sales trends across 30K dataset records.
caseStudies.approach: Built a dynamic Power BI analytics dashboard featuring key KPI summaries ($822.93K Warehouse Sales, $197.82K Retail Transfers, $208.19K Retail Sales), category bar & donut charts, detailed product matrix values, and monthly trend line comparisons. Implemented multi-slicer filtering for Year, Month, Item Type, Supplier, and Item Code.

caseStudies.title: HEALTHCARE ANALYTICS DASHBOARD
caseStudies.platforms: Power BI, Data Visualization, SQL, Data Cleaning
caseStudies.goal: Provide a comprehensive overview of hospital patient admission metrics, department referral counts, satisfaction scores, demographic distributions, and admission flags.
caseStudies.approach: Processed patient record datasets and built interactive Power BI visualizations including department referral horizontal bar charts, gender & admission donut charts, monthly admission volume timeline graphs, and a patient race treemap. Added key insights callouts and slicers for Department, Gender, and Date Range.

caseStudies.title: CONSUMER SHOPPING TRENDS
caseStudies.platforms: Power BI, DAX, Customer Segmentation, Excel
caseStudies.goal: Uncover consumer spending behaviors, comparing online vs in-store order metrics across demographic age groups (Senior, Adult, Young), gender segments, and city tiers.
caseStudies.approach: Structured multi-channel retail data into a Power BI interactive dashboard ($2Bn total spend, $879M online spend, $892M store spend). Visualized online vs store spend by age group with clustered bar charts, online order frequency trends, age group spend donut charts, gender breakdown, and interactive city tier button slicers.

caseStudies.title: AUTOMATED METER READING
caseStudies.goal: Automate utility meter reading to eliminate manual entry errors, reduce processing time, and speed up billing operations.
caseStudies.approach: Developed a web-based application that integrates a webcam to capture real-time images of analog/digital utility meters. Implemented Tesseract OCR (Optical Character Recognition) to extract numerical digits from the images and store them in a database.
